mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, phone, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role}, NOW(), NOW())

mapper.update: update users set password = #{password} where id = #{id}

update users set photo = #{photo} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,username,role,photo,nick_name FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
